title: leggedrobotics/pace-sim2real
abstract:
PACE: A systematic approach for sim-to-real transfer of legged robots, identifying actuator and joint dynamics with standard joint encoders.

# ⚙️ PACE — Sim-to-Real Transfer for Legged Robots PACE is a framework for **sim-to-real transfer of diverse robotic systems**, combining data-driven system identification with evolutionary optimization. It enables accurate actuator modeling and robust adaptation between simulation to reality by explicitly learning physically meaningful dynamics parameters. --- ## 🤖🐾 What is PACE? PACE (Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution) bridges the gap between simulation and real hardware by: * Estimating actuator and joint dynamics directly from measured data * Using CMA-ES for parameter optimization * Applying learned parameters to improve sim-to-real locomotion performance * Supporting multiple robot platforms and actuator types It is designed to integrate seamlessly with **NVIDIA Isaac Lab** and follows its task and environment conventions. --- ## 📦 Installation ### 1. Install Isaac Lab Follow the official Isaac Lab installation guide: [https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html) We recommend using the **conda** or **uv** installation method, as this simplifies running Python scripts from the terminal and managing dependencies. ### 2. Clone this repository Clone or copy this project separately from the Isaac Lab installation (i.e. outside the `IsaacLab` directory): ### 3. Install PACE in editable mode Using a Python interpreter that has Isaac Lab installed: ### ⚠️ Isaac Sim version compatibility PACE is developed and tested against **Isaac Sim 5.0 / Isaac Lab (latest)**. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：PACE 用标准关节编码器采集的激励数据做数据驱动的系统辨识，以 CMA-ES 进化策略拟合具有物理意义的执行器/关节动力学参数，再把学到的参数回填到 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 的仿真环境中，从而闭环提升腿足机器人的 sim-to-real 运动性能。


# 一、动机

> 腿足机器人从仿真迁移到真机时，执行器与关节动力学（摩擦、延迟、力矩缩放等未建模效应）造成显著的 sim-to-real gap，而现有做法多依赖昂贵的力矩传感器或手工调参，难以在不同机器人平台与执行器类型间通用。


# 二、方法

> PACE 用标准关节编码器采集的激励数据做数据驱动的系统辨识，以 CMA-ES 进化策略拟合具有物理意义的执行器/关节动力学参数，再把学到的参数回填到 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 的仿真环境中，从而闭环提升腿足机器人的 sim-to-real 运动性能。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文以工程框架形式发布（leggedrobotics/pace-sim2real），流程为：在仿真中采集激励数据（或替换为自采真机数据）→ 用 CMA-ES 拟合参数 → 将参数应用到 Isaac Lab 的 locomotion 任务；框架声明支持多种机器人平台与执行器类型，并与 Isaac Lab 任务/环境规范无缝集成（基于 Isaac Sim 5.0 开发测试）。摘要与仓库说明中未给出具体的成功率、跟踪误差或迁移性能提升数值，具体量化结论需查阅正文。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限在于：参数辨识依赖激励轨迹的质量与覆盖度，通常仍需针对每个新平台/新执行器重新采集数据与拟合，且需要标准关节编码器可见的关节侧信息；启发是可把 CMA-ES 这类无梯度黑箱优化与物理参数化建模结合，作为低成本（无需力矩传感器）的 sim-to-real 校准环节，与强化学习策略训练解耦、可复用。
